text.dialogs.rctmod.default.wrong_series.0: Hey there! It looks like you haven't started the right series yet. Get going, and then we can battle!
text.dialogs.rctmod.default.wrong_series.1: I admire your enthusiasm, but you need to begin the correct series before you can challenge me.
text.dialogs.rctmod.default.wrong_series.10: I see you're ready to battle, but you haven't started the required challenges yet. Get going!
text.dialogs.rctmod.default.wrong_series.11: You're on the wrong track! Start the necessary series, and then we can have our showdown.
text.dialogs.rctmod.default.wrong_series.12: I can't accept your challenge right now. You need to begin the earlier battles first!
text.dialogs.rctmod.default.wrong_series.13: You're not ready for this challenge yet! Make sure to start the correct series before stepping up.
text.dialogs.rctmod.default.wrong_series.14: You're not in the right series for this battle! Focus on starting the correct challenges, and then we can fight.
text.dialogs.rctmod.default.wrong_series.15: I love your enthusiasm, but you need to embark on the right series before we can battle!
text.dialogs.rctmod.default.wrong_series.2: Not quite ready for me! Make sure to start the right series first if you want to face me.
text.dialogs.rctmod.default.wrong_series.3: Whoa! You're not on the right path for this challenge. Begin the correct series before stepping up to me!
text.dialogs.rctmod.default.wrong_series.4: I can't battle you just yet. You need to start the right series to earn your chance to fight me!
text.dialogs.rctmod.default.wrong_series.5: You're eager, I like that! But you must begin the necessary challenges before you can take me on.
text.dialogs.rctmod.default.wrong_series.6: Hold on! You haven't started the required series. Make sure you're ready for this fight!
text.dialogs.rctmod.default.wrong_series.7: I appreciate your spirit, but you need to embark on the right journey first. Then we can battle!
text.dialogs.rctmod.default.wrong_series.8: You're not quite there! Make sure to start the necessary series before challenging me.
text.dialogs.rctmod.default.wrong_series.9: Nice effort, but you need to begin the correct series to battle me. Keep training hard!
text.gui.rctmod.trainer_association.series_co: Continue your journey where you left off.
text.gui.rctmod.trainer_association.series_re: Starting a new series will reset your current series progression! In return completing a series will permanently increase your luck for better loot from trainers.
text.series.rctmod.bdsp.description: A casual series but still with decent difficulty. Are you ready to conquer Sinnoh?
text.series.rctmod.bdsp.title: Brilliant Diamond/Shining Pearl
text.series.rctmod.empty.title: No Series
text.series.rctmod.freeroam.description: Pause your current series and enjoy the freedom of no level cap restriction. Keep in mind that resuming will revert the level cap back.
text.series.rctmod.freeroam.title: Freeroam
text.series.rctmod.radicalred.description: A difficult series taking place in the Kanto region. Are you up to the challenge?
text.series.rctmod.radicalred.title: Radical Red
text.series.rctmod.unbound.description: A dispute between two mysterious organizations is causing trouble in the Borrious region. Who knows what destiny has in store for you.
text.series.rctmod.unbound.title: Unbound
